parsed.rationale_overall: System A provides a more coherent and directly responsive year-by-year glide path with concrete tickers, allocation percentages, and complementary recommendations (tax optimization, Roth conversions) that strengthen actionability and grounding. System B has stronger explicit personalization references but contains internal inconsistencies (e.g., calling 55% equity a reduction 'to 70%', confusing year numbering) that undermine factual grounding and actionability.
